title: Enterprise plugin market
intro: Administrators import plugins. Employees can install validated plugins from DSH Desktop.
name: Plugin
loadFailed: The operation failed. Please try again.
empty: Import an offline release bundle to publish your first plugin.
uploadHint: Choose a complete offline ZIP bundle up to 256 MiB. Employees can install it after validation. A newly imported version becomes current; check the version before importing.
invalidFile: Select a ZIP bundle up to 256 MiB
deleteConfirm: Delete {{name}}? New installations and updates will stop. Existing installations can continue running. You can import the plugin again later.
bundleSource: Obtain a DSH enterprise plugin offline release bundle from the plugin developer or your enterprise administrator.
bundleFormat: The bundle must contain manifest.json, the plugin and all dependencies for each supported operating system, and a SHA-256 file inventory.
bundleIdentity: Within an enterprise, plugin.name in manifest.json identifies the plugin and version identifies its release. A given version must keep identical bundle contents.
